description: This file defines a feature to list tags, including a Query class implementing IRequest and a QueryHandler handling the request by querying the database context to retrieve tags.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents a request to retrieve a list of tags wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query request by querying the database context for tags, ordering them by TagId, and returning them wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query request asynchronously, retrieves tags from the database, and returns them wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.
